operator_io_quirks: Mixed-case table names: "Author", "Conference", "Journal" quoted; Paper and PaperAuthor unquoted in DDL — must double-quote all identifiers.
Paper has 2,254,920 rows and PaperAuthor 2,315,574 rows — far above max_rows_per_table=300000; rowid%k sampling required, original_values truncated.
Author.Id distinct=200000 but rows=247030 — PK declared but NOT unique in data; sample_fresh_primary_keys will drop ~47k rows.
Paper.Id distinct=200000 vs 2.25M rows — same PK-duplicate situation; huge drop on PK filter.
PaperAuthor has NO primary key (pk=[]) — sample_fresh_primary_keys is a no-op; no unique column either.
Paper.ConferenceId and Paper.JournalId contain value 0 which is NOT in Conference.Id/Journal.Id (min Id=1) — dangling FK values in original; fill_foreign_keys_consistently will not reproduce them.
PaperAuthor.PaperId distinct=32935 vs Paper.Id 200000 — FK child values are a small subset; parent-side sampling with replacement will over-spread.
All columns notnull=0 despite PKs — NOT NULL not enforced; NULLs appear in Name/Affiliation/Title/Keyword storage.
Affiliation/Keyword/Title contain '|', ';', ',' separators and unicode (Guðmundur, Für) — String fuzzer CHARSET a-zA-Z0-9() will not reproduce; contaminate adds ASCII only.
Empty strings present in Conference.ShortName/HomePage and Journal.ShortName — String length range [0,20] can produce them but not reliably.
Year is INTEGER with 161 distinct values (1963..2009) — Number fuzzer will draw from [-10^scale,10^scale] not the year range; no date dispatch.
HomePage values are URLs (http://...) — String fuzzer treats as generic text; no FORMAT dispatch.
operator_ts_expectations: All Id/Year/ConferenceId/JournalId/PaperId/AuthorId columns dispatch to Number fuzzer (INTEGER, no args) — scale=0, range [-1,1] perturbed by ±1/±2; will produce tiny integers, not realistic Ids.
Name/Title/Affiliation/ShortName/FullName/HomePage/Keyword dispatch to String fuzzer (TEXT) — random a-zA-Z0-9() strings length 0-20 plus contaminate; implausible for names/URLs/titles.
Number fuzzer on Id columns: list_max quirk (min(el), max(el)+1 overwritten by full-range max) means fresh draws span [-1,1] not the observed Id range — FN risk on Id-range predicates.
String fuzzer on Affiliation/Keyword: original values contain '|'/';' separators and unicode; fuzzer never emits these — LIKE '%|%' or unicode predicates will miss.
Year as Number: fuzzer draws from [-1,1]±perturb, never 1963-2009 — any Year BETWEEN 1990 AND 2000 predicate yields empty; FP/FN on year filters.
PaperAuthor has no PK and no unique column — drop_unique_duplicates no-op; duplicate (PaperId,AuthorId) pairs will appear, unlike original which likely has none.
FK fill: Paper.ConferenceId drawn from Conference.Id final values (1..4545) — value 0 in original never reproduced; queries filtering ConferenceId=0 miss.
FK fill: PaperAuthor.PaperId drawn from Paper.Id (200000 distinct after PK filter) — original only has 32935 distinct PaperIds; join cardinalities inflated.
Author.Id PK filter drops ~19% of rows (247030→200000) — Author row count in instance ~200k not 247k; COUNT(*) predicates on Author will differ.
Paper.Id PK filter drops ~91% of rows (2.25M→200k) — Paper instance ~200k rows; any COUNT/aggregate on Paper massively off.
Empty-string ShortName/HomePage: String fuzzer can emit '' but p=0.2 fresh + contaminate rarely yields exactly ''; queries testing empty-string equality may miss.

NULL rates: Affiliation ~60%, Keyword ~77%, Title ~7% — String fuzzer drops None elements and p=0.2 fresh; NULLs only via insert-fail on NOT NULL (none here) — instance will have ~0 NULLs, original has many; IS NULL predicates miss.
